mapper.select: SELECT * FROM feed_price_reference WHERE normalized_item_name = #{normalizedItemName} AND COALESCE(brand, '') = COALESCE(#{brand}, '') AND unit = #{unit} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_price_reference (normalized_item_name, display_item_name, brand, unit, category, lowest_price, source, source_url, observed_at, expires_at, search_confidence) VALUES (#{normalizedItemName}, #{displayItemName}, #{brand}, #{unit}, #{category}, #{lowestPrice}, #{source}, #{sourceUrl}, #{observedAt}, DATE_ADD(#{observedAt}, INTERVAL 7 DAY), #{searchConfidence}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_item_name = VALUES(display_item_name), category = VALUES(category), lowest_price = VALUES(lowest_price), source = VALUES(source), source_url = VALUES(source_url), observed_at = VALUES(observed_at), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), search_confidence = VALUES(search_confidence), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
